**Şadi Evren Şeker** has worked in the information technology sector since 1997 and teaches artificial intelligence and computer science at the university level.

He completed his B.Sc., M.Sc. and Ph.D. degrees in computer science and engineering; his master's and doctoral theses were in artificial intelligence, on natural language processing. He did postdoctoral research at The University of Texas at Dallas, where he worked on big data analytics. He was a visiting professor of computer science at Smith College in 2016–2017. In Turkey he became an associate professor of management information systems in 2015 and a full professor in 2020; he chaired the Department of Business Administration at Istanbul Medeniyet University (2014–2015) and later served as dean of the Faculty of Computer and Information Technologies at Istanbul University.

He has lived and worked in six countries, as an academic, expert and consultant in the United States, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. He has a long record of consulting and training for leading companies in banking, tourism, transportation, airlines, finance, insurance and telecommunications. He is active in the startup ecosystem, with a track record of 18 startups, and he holds many commercialized international patents for a range of industries.

His published work includes many books, research on a computerized argument Delphi technique (*IEEE Access*, 2015), a study of large language models in software development (*Electrica*, 2026), and many Turkish-language entries in *YBS Ansiklopedi*, the management information systems encyclopedia whose entries appear in this book's From the Field sections. He develops HermAI, an open-source Python package for hermeneutic explainable AI, presented in a published article with Arslanhan (Seker & Arslanhan, 2026, *Artificial Intelligence Theory and Applications*, 6(1), 56–74). For many years he has taught computer science to a wide audience through the *Bilgisayar Kavramlari* (Computer Concepts) YouTube channel, which had more than 280,000 subscribers in October 2026.

He is a founder of OptiWisdom, which develops Compass, this book's optional digital companion, and software for businesses, including AI tools, and the founder of Bilkav Egitim Danismanlik ("How This Book Was Written" declares these interests).
